name: MACHINE ODDS LIVE: Behemoth Combat Betting Exchange
description: MACHINE ODDS LIVE is a licensed live-betting exchange tied to the SHATTER DOME and WRECK PROTOCOL Behemoth combat series, offering real-time wagering on autonomous machine performance including round-by-round damage accumulation, subsystem failure prediction, and final destruction method. Unlike fighter-based betting, Behemoth odds are driven entirely by mechanical data — pre-match diagnostics, material composition analysis, and historical performance logs — which has attracted a distinct demographic of technically-minded bettors who treat the exchange as an engineering prediction game rather than a traditional gambling product. The exchange is operated by Ferrous Latitude Pictures under a Sable Charter sports betting license.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 fabricator realizes they can predict Behemoth failures before they happen because they're the one doing the pre-fight repairs — and someone finds out they've been betting on it.

A MACHINE ODDS LIVE algorithm has started producing odds that are statistically too accurate, and the exchange's risk management team suspects someone has unauthorized access to pre-match diagnostic feeds.
A character discovers that a specific Behemoth has been deliberately losing fights for three seasons — but it's an autonomous machine with no operator, so who's manipulating it and how?
